analysis.title: Recorrelation drives vols higher // AI cross-asset hedges // SX5E vol // Equity longs // Yen vs CHF
key_insights: UBS Sales and Trading (Shane Carroll, 10-Nov-2026) says re-correlation helped drive some historic equity moves this week, but VIX is back below 20 and contagion so far is limited.
UBS Research's 'AI Disappoints' downside scenario points to potential hedges via Gold, Rates and SPX.
UBS Research favours owning European vol and suggests hedging downside via SX5E put-spreads.
UBS Research's preferred equity longs are NDX, KOSPI2 and Global Industrials, with a suggestion to fund them by selling XLY calls.
UBS Research favours long Yen vs short CHF. Alternatives to play a rebound are NKY/JPY Hybrids and AUD/CHF Dual Digis.

The note is Sales and Trading commentary, not a product of UBS Research. The text extraction contains only the headline summaries. The supporting charts and trade tables on pages 2-6 did not come through as text.
